blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY, Philippines — Jonathan Lacdagan Landong, a Higaonon, has spent 20 years teaching and serving the indigenous people’s (IP) community in Limonda village of Opol town, Misamis Oriental that he calls home. Despite the challenges inherent in the deployment to a remote hinterland barangay, Landong chose to stay when an opportunity was presented him to relocate to a cozier assignment at the town center. His path to teaching was shaped by hardship. As a child, he walked long distances from the village to the nearest elementary and high school campus along rocky, muddy and overgrown paths, sometimes arriving home late […]...
